parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of NaN comparison in matrix determinants by modifying the pivot-finding function and adding a tolerance parameter to the random complex number generator. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The addition of the `tolerance` parameter to `random_complex_number` is not aligned with the existing function signature and could be considered a minor API change.
